kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi create-card-sms-template --template-name '阿里云图文类模板' --template key=example-string --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCardSmsTemplate

parameters.help_en: The name of the card SMS template
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The content of the card SMS template.

For descriptions of fields such as Template, ExtendInfo, TemplateContent, TmpCard, and Action, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434929.html.
The content structure varies depending on the type of card SMS template. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/435361.html
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信的模板内容。

Template、ExtendInfo、TemplateContent、TmpCard、Action等字段说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434929.html。
不同类型的卡片短信模板的内容结构不同，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/435361.html
parameters.name: template

parameters.help_en: The description of the uploaded template
parameters.name: memo

parameters.help_en:
The manufacturers to which the template is submitted. Valid values:

HuaWei: Huawei.
XiaoMi: Xiaomi.
OPPO: OPPO.
VIVO: VIVO.
MEIZU: Meizu.
HONOR: Honor.

If this parameter is not specified, the system automatically matches the mobile phone manufacturers that support the template
parameters.help_zh:
模板提交的厂商。厂商类型取值：

HuaWei：表示华为厂商。
XiaoMi：表示小米厂商。
OPPO：表示OPPO厂商。
VIVO：表示VIVO厂商。
MEIZU：表示魅族厂商。
HONOR：表示荣耀厂商。

该参数不填时，系统自动匹配模板支持的手机厂商
parameters.name: factorys

Code.description_en:
The request status code. Valid values:

OK: The request was successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

TemplateCode.description_en:
The code of the card SMS template. You can view the Template Code on the Template Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card) page in the Card SMS section of the console.

The template must be added and approved
TemplateCode.description_zh:
卡片短信模板Code。您可以在控制台卡片短信模板管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card)页面查看模板Code。

必须是已添加、并通过审核的卡片短信模板

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
